name: Leon Sooleawa
source: Leon is a mysterious boy and lives in the woods. Elenor is not really sure what to make of him and he often teases her. On the other hand, he seems to be quite serious at times. He also seems to be all alone, he has no family and maybe no friends at all. Jack doesn’t like him either and suddenly Elenor begins to wonder: Maybe he wants to be alone after  all. What is he hiding? Can Elenor reveal his secrets?
